preconditions.description: The number of computers n is between 1 and 1500 inclusive.
The diagonal elements of the matrix a are all zero.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][j] > 0 for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i != j)
preconditions.description: All off-diagonal elements of the matrix a are positive.

preconditions.expression: all(a[i][j] == a[j][i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
len({a[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if i < j}) == n * (n - 1) // 2
preconditions.description: All a[i][j] for i < j are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is a space-separated list of n integers, where the k-th integer (1 ≤ k ≤ n) is the number of valid ways to partition the n computers into k non-empty groups, modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= 998244352 for count in counts)
postconditions.description: Each count in the output is a non-negative integer less than 998244353.
